parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Study Fig. 3.2, which shows information about two earthquakes which occurred in 2018.
Venezuela 21 August 2018
The August 2018 Venezuela earthquake measured 7.3 on the
Richter scale and was one of the largest earthquakes ever to strike
Venezuela. It occurred at a depth of 154 kilometres and was felt
as far away as Bogotá, Colombia and Paramaribo, Suriname. The
earthquake killed five people.
Indonesia 28 September 2018
Following the earthquake in Indonesia measuring 7.5 on the Richter
scale, at a depth of 20 kilometres, a tsunami occurred. This had a
height of around 5 to 7 metres, and flooded the settlements of Palu,
Donggala and Mamuju. At least 2256 people were confirmed killed,
with hundreds more missing.
